commit_message: Add ADR0127 Native 2D Editor workspace base
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Isolates the first two Native 2D Editor workspace changes for current-main v8: stable SpriteRef scene-entity creation through the existing EditorSession transaction and the initial unused workspace module source. This intentionally leaves the module unregistered so remaining workspace authoring can be preflighted independently.
